items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf) for Week 7; will test pregame per McVay. Crucial slate status.
items.why: Calf injury felt mid-practice Thursday; no full explosion/power; DNP Friday.
items.implication: Game-time decision; hierarchy shifts if OUT.

items.text: Lamar Jackson QUESTIONABLE (high ankle sprain) vs CIN; heading in right direction but status key.
items.why: High ankle; practiced/seen working; self-described right direction.
items.implication: Ravens offense ceiling hinges on availability.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad); return/practice noted but status critical for Jets.
items.implication: If active vs MIA, high start confidence.

items.text: Mike Evans OUT (Achilles) vs ATL; confirmed by coach/ Shanahan.
items.implication: 49ers WR room gutted with Deebo also OUT.
items.opportunity: Kittle funnel, remaining WRs, CMC slot

items.text: If Puka OUT, Stafford targets: 1 Higbee, 2 Mumpfield, 3 Parkinson, 4 Atwell, 5 Whittington, 6 Allen. Adams already multi-week OUT drives TE-heavy.
items.why: Calf minor but pregame test; prior Adams-out 13-personnel spike to 86%.
items.opportunity: TE target share spike (prior 37% when Puka out)

items.text: Deebo Samuel OUT with Evans for 49ers vs ATL.

items.implication: Rams TE-heavy personnel likely with Puka Q.

items.text: Rashee Rice OUT confirmed in Sunday dump and Schefter list.
Jeremiyah Love OUT (high ankle) another week; coach ruled.
David Montgomery OUT; listed with Jahwar Jordan.
items.implication: HOU/DET? RB committee change (note list HOU).

items.text: Tyler Warren OUT (groin); Colts coach ruled with Sauce.
Josh Jacobs IN; facility access (meetings/lifting/treatment) noted; backups poor EPA.

items.implication: Likely lead if active; long-term outlook discussed.

items.text: Bijan full opportunity vs SF: BRob OUT + SF DvP inflates opp RB +4.4% (7th most); recent RB catches high (White/Holani/Harvey/Love).
items.why: Brian Robinson Jr hamstring OUT; SF conceding RB production.
items.implication: Elite RB1 spot with full workload.
